description.subtitle: Children's T-shirt of the first equipment Al-Hilal Puma 2025 2025 - blue
description.tagline: Blue Passion for the Little Ones
description.intro: The Al-Hilal 2025/26 children's shirt allows young fans to live their passion from a young age. With comfortable materials and a design identical to that of professionals, it is perfect for playing, training or cheering up their favorite team.
key_benefits: Club identity: Design inspired by the first official equipment of the Al-Hilal.
Comfort for children: Soft and breathable fabric designed for day to day.
Ideal for any occasion: Suitable for sport, leisure or entertainment in the stadium.
Modern design: Youth court with great freedom of movement.
Sustainable manufacturing: Made with recycled materials that care for the planet.

source.subtitle: Camiseta infantil de la primera equipación Puma del Al-Hilal 2025 2026 - azul
source.tagline: Pasión azul para los más pequeños

key_benefits: Identidad de club: Diseño inspirado en la primera equipación oficial del Al-Hilal.
Comodidad para niños: Tejido suave y transpirable pensado para el día a día.
Ideal para cualquier ocasión: Apta para deporte, ocio o animar en el estadio.
Diseño moderno: Corte juvenil con gran libertad de movimiento.
